name: set_household_setting
purpose: Set one of the household's own settings -- its timezone, its default currency, the auto-confirm threshold and quiet period. Always an admin's own decision (ADR 0034: a setting the household changes is a row, never an environment variable), so a non-admin's attempt is refused at the database.

key.description: For example timezone, default_currency, auto_confirm_threshold_minor, auto_confirm_quiet_period_hours.

value.description: Stored as JSON; a number is written as a number, anything else as a string.
